blocks.text: O'zbek tilida «ham» yuklamasi darak gapda ham, inkor gapda ham bir xil: «Men **ham** charchadim», «Men **ham** bormadim». Ingliz tilida esa ikki xil so'z bor: darak gapda — **too**, inkor gapda — **either**. Ikkalasi odatda **gap oxirida** turadi (o'zbekcha «ham» esa tegishli so'zdan keyin, gap o'rtasida): Aziz is a doctor, and his wife is a doctor **too**. Tom can't swim, and I can't swim **either**.

items.text: My sister lives in Tashkent, and my brother lives there **too**.
items.translation: Opam Toshkentda yashaydi, akam **ham** o'sha yerda yashaydi.

items.text: I didn't see the match, and Bekzod didn't see it **either**.
We aren't from London, and our friends aren't **either**.
items.translation: Biz Londondan emasmiz, do'stlarimiz **ham** Londondan emas.

blocks.text: Tipik xato — inkor gapda too: «I don't like fish too.» → **I don't like fish either.** O'zbekcha «ham» ikkala holatda bir xil bo'lgani uchun bu xato juda ko'p uchraydi. Qoida: gapda **not** (n't) bo'lsa — **either**.
So am I / Neither do I: «Men ham»

Kimdir o'zi haqida gapirsa va siz ham shunday bo'lsangiz, o'zbekcha qisqagina «Men **ham**.» deysiz. Inglizcha javob ham qisqa, lekin unda yordamchi fe'l bo'lishi shart: darak gapga — **So + yordamchi fe'l + ega**, inkor gapga — **Neither + yordamchi fe'l + ega**. I'm tired. — **So am I**. I don't smoke. — **Neither do I**. Yordamchi fe'l 40-darsdagi qoida bilan tanlanadi: be, have, can, will bo'lsa — o'sha; Present Simple va Past Simple da — do / does / did.

Nega so'z tartibi teskari? **So** va **Neither** dan keyin xuddi savoldagidek yordamchi fe'l egadan **oldin** keladi: So **am I** («So I am» emas), Neither **does she**. Gap boshidagi so / neither shunday tartibni talab qiladi. Ega ot ham bo'lishi mumkin: Bekzod is hungry, and **so is his brother**. **Neither** dan keyin fe'l doim darak shaklda: Neither **do** I («Neither don't I» emas) — ingliz gapida bitta inkor bo'ladi, neither ning o'zi inkor.

items.text: I'm a big fan of football. — **So am I**!
Emma doesn't eat fish, and **neither does** her husband.
I've lost my umbrella. — **So have I**! What a day.
items.translation: Soyabonimni yo'qotib qo'ydim. — Men **ham**! Qanday kun bo'ldi-ya.

items.text: Madina can't drive, and **neither can** her sister.

blocks.text: Xuddi shu ma'noni boshqacha ham aytish mumkin: So am I = I am **too**; Neither do I = I don't **either**. So'zlashuvda juda ko'p eshitiladigan qisqa shakllar: **Me too.** (= So am I / So do I) va **Me neither.** (= Neither am I / Neither do I). Ular norasmiy, lekin tabiiy va har qanday zamon bilan ishlaydi, chunki yordamchi fe'l talab qilmaydi.
**Nor** = neither (Nor do I) — ma'nosi bir xil, biroz rasmiyroq. **neither** ning boshqa ma'nosi — «ikkalasi ham ... emas» (neither of them) — → 82-dars.
Rozi bo'lmasangiz: Oh, I'm not. / Really? I do.

Agar siz suhbatdoshingizdek bo'lmasangiz, so / neither ishlatilmaydi — oddiy qisqa javob beriladi (→ 40-dars): darak gapga inkor, inkor gapga darak. I'm hungry. — Oh, **I'm not**. I don't like jazz. — Really? **I do**. O'zbekchada bu «esa» bilan aytiladi: «Men **esa** och emasman», «Menga **esa** yoqadi».

items.text: I'm going to bed early tonight. — Oh, **I'm not**. I want to watch the film.
items.translation: Bugun erta yotaman. — Men esa **yotmayman**. Filmni ko'rmoqchiman.

items.text: I didn't enjoy the party. — Didn't you? **I did**!
items.translation: Ziyofat menga yoqmadi. — Shunaqami? Menga esa **yoqdi**!

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I'm tired. — So do I.» → **So am I.** (gapda am — javobda ham be); «So I am.» → **So am I.** (so'z tartibi); «I don't like it. — Me too.» → **Me neither.** yoki **Neither do I.**; «Neither I don't.» → **Neither do I.**

Eslab qolish: **So** — darak gapga rozilik, **Neither** — inkor gapga rozilik. Ikkalasidan keyin tartib savoldagidek: **yordamchi fe'l + ega** (so **do I**, neither **can she**). Yordamchi fe'lni esa birinchi gapdan oling.

items: Darak gapda «ham» — **too**, inkor gapda — **either** (ikkalasi gap oxirida).
Darak gapga rozilik: **So + yordamchi fe'l + ega** — So am I. / So does Tom. / So did we.
Inkor gapga rozilik: **Neither + yordamchi fe'l + ega** — Neither do I. / Neither can she.
Rozi bo'lmasangiz — oddiy qisqa javob: Oh, **I'm not**. / Really? **I do**.

examples.title: **too**: positive sentences
examples.description: Darak gapda «ham» — **too**, u odatda gap oxirida turadi: My wife is a doctor **too** — Xotinim **ham** shifokor.

sentences.text: Aziz is a doctor, and his wife is a doctor **too**.
sentences.translation: Aziz shifokor, xotini **ham** shifokor.

sentences.text: I love Samarkand, and I like Bukhara **too**.
sentences.translation: Samarqandni juda yaxshi ko'raman, Buxoro **ham** yoqadi.

sentences.text: Emma speaks Spanish, and she speaks a little Uzbek **too**.
sentences.translation: Emma ispancha gapiradi, ozgina o'zbekcha **ham** gapiradi.

sentences.text: It was cold yesterday, and it was windy **too**.
sentences.translation: Kecha sovuq edi, shamol **ham** bor edi.

sentences.text: We bought bread and milk, and some fruit **too**.
sentences.translation: Non va sut oldik, biroz meva **ham** oldik.

sentences.text: My brother plays the guitar, and he sings **too**.
sentences.translation: Akam gitara chaladi, qo'shiq **ham** aytadi.

sentences.text: Sarah has visited Tashkent, and her parents have been there **too**.
sentences.translation: Sara Toshkentga borgan, ota-onasi **ham** u yerda bo'lgan.

sentences.text: Is Bekzod coming tonight? — Yes, and his cousin is coming **too**.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun Bekzod keladimi? — Ha, amakivachchasi **ham** keladi.

sentences.text: The hotel was comfortable, and the staff were friendly **too**.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona qulay edi, xodimlar **ham** samimiy edi.

sentences.text: You're going to the market? Please buy some onions **too**.
sentences.translation: Bozorga boryapsizmi? Iltimos, piyoz **ham** olib keling.

examples.title: **either**: negative sentences
examples.description: Inkor gapda «ham» — **either** (too emas!): Tom doesn't know it **either** — Tom **ham** bilmaydi.

sentences.text: I don't know the answer, and Tom doesn't know it **either**.
sentences.translation: Men javobni bilmayman, Tom **ham** bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Madina didn't come to class, and her sister didn't come **either**.
sentences.translation: Madina darsga kelmadi, singlisi **ham** kelmadi.

sentences.text: The food wasn't good, and it wasn't cheap **either**.
sentences.translation: Taom mazali emasdi, arzon **ham** emasdi.

sentences.text: I can't swim, and my husband can't **either**.
sentences.translation: Men suzishni bilmayman, erim **ham** bilmaydi.

sentences.text: We haven't been to Oxford, and we haven't seen Cambridge **either**.
sentences.translation: Biz Oksfordda bo'lmaganmiz, Kembrijni **ham** ko'rmaganmiz.

sentences.text: My phone isn't working, and the internet isn't working **either**.
sentences.translation: Telefonim ishlamayapti, internet **ham** ishlamayapti.

sentences.text: Bekzod doesn't eat sugar, and he doesn't drink tea **either**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod shakar yemaydi, choy **ham** ichmaydi.

sentences.text: Sarah isn't coming to the party, so I'm not going **either**.
sentences.translation: Sara ziyofatga kelmayapti, shuning uchun men **ham** bormayman.

sentences.text: There wasn't any bread in the shop, and there wasn't any milk **either**.
sentences.translation: Do'konda non yo'q edi, sut **ham** yo'q edi.

sentences.text: I didn't understand the film, and to be honest, I didn't like it **either**.
sentences.translation: Filmni tushunmadim, rostini aytsam, menga yoqmadi **ham**.

examples.title: **So am I** / **So is she** / **So were they**
examples.description: **be** bilan rozilik: **So + am / is / are / was / were + ega**. Ega ot ham bo'lishi mumkin: so **is** his sister, so **were** the restaurants.

sentences.text: I'm really tired today. — **So am I**.
sentences.translation: Bugun juda charchadim. — Men **ham**.

sentences.text: Aziz is from Samarkand. — Really? **So is** my wife.
sentences.translation: Aziz Samarqanddan. — Rostdanmi? Xotinim **ham**.

sentences.text: My parents were at the concert, and **so were** Dilnoza's.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam konsertda edi, Dilnozaning ota-onasi **ham**.

sentences.text: We're going to the cinema tonight. — **So are we**! Which film?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun kinoga boryapmiz. — Biz **ham**! Qaysi film?

sentences.text: The first test was difficult, and **so was** the second one.
sentences.translation: Birinchi test qiyin edi, ikkinchisi **ham**.

sentences.text: Tom is interested in history. — **So is** his sister.
sentences.translation: Tom tarixga qiziqadi. — Singlisi **ham**.

sentences.text: I was late for work this morning. — **So was I**. The traffic was terrible.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab ishga kechikdim. — Men **ham**. Tirbandlik dahshatli edi.

sentences.text: The hotel in London was expensive, and **so were** the restaurants.
sentences.translation: Londondagi mehmonxona qimmat edi, restoranlar **ham**.

sentences.text: Emma is nervous about the interview, and **so is** James.
sentences.translation: Emma suhbatdan oldin hayajonda, Jeyms **ham**.

sentences.text: Madina's very busy this week. — **So is** Bekzod. They're both working on a big project.
sentences.translation: Madina bu hafta juda band. — Bekzod **ham**. Ikkalasi katta loyiha ustida ishlayapti.

examples.title: **So do I** / **So does he** / **So did we**
examples.description: Present Simple va Past Simple gapiga rozilik: **So do / does / did + ega**. Gapda yordamchi fe'l ko'rinmasa ham, javobda u bo'lishi shart.

sentences.text: I love Uzbek bread. — **So do I**. It's the best!
sentences.translation: O'zbek nonini juda yaxshi ko'raman. — Men **ham**. Eng zo'ri shu!

sentences.text: Bekzod works at the weekend, and **so does** his brother.
sentences.translation: Bekzod dam olish kunlari ishlaydi, akasi **ham**.

sentences.text: We went to Bukhara in spring. — Really? **So did we**!
sentences.translation: Bahorda Buxoroga bordik. — Rostdanmi? Biz **ham**!

sentences.text: My daughter wants a dog. — **So does** my son. Every day he asks for one.
sentences.translation: Qizim it olishni xohlaydi. — O'g'lim **ham**. Har kuni so'raydi.

sentences.text: Sarah enjoyed the trip, and **so did** her husband.
sentences.translation: Saraga sayohat yoqdi, eriga **ham**.

sentences.text: I usually get up at six. — **So do I**, even on Sundays.
sentences.translation: Odatda soat oltida turaman. — Men **ham**, hatto yakshanba kunlari.

sentences.text: Madina passed all her exams, and **so did** her best friend.
sentences.translation: Madina barcha imtihonlardan o'tdi, eng yaqin dugonasi **ham**.

sentences.text: Tom forgot about the meeting. — **So did** I! What did we miss?
sentences.translation: Tom yig'ilishni unutib qo'ydi. — Men **ham**! Nimani o'tkazib yubordik?

sentences.text: Our neighbours often go to Turkey on holiday, and **so do** we.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz ta'tilda tez-tez Turkiyaga borishadi, biz **ham**.

sentences.text: Aziz felt ill after the fish. — **So did** Emma. Maybe it wasn't fresh.
sentences.translation: Baliqdan keyin Azizning tobi qochdi. — Emmaning **ham**. Balki u yangi emasdir.

examples.title: **So have I**, **so can she**, **so will we**
examples.description: Gapda have / has, can, will, would, should bo'lsa — rozilikda ham o'sha: I've finished. — **So have I**. She can swim, and **so can** her brother.

sentences.text: I've finished my homework. — **So have I**. Let's go out.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifamni tugatdim. — Men **ham**. Keling, tashqariga chiqamiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza can speak three languages, and **so can** her brother.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza uchta tilda gapira oladi, akasi **ham**.

sentences.text: We'll be at the wedding on Saturday. — **So will we**.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni to'yda bo'lamiz. — Biz **ham**.

sentences.text: Tom has seen this film three times, and **so has** Emma.
sentences.translation: Tom bu filmni uch marta ko'rgan, Emma **ham**.

sentences.text: I can ride a horse. — Really? **So can I**! My grandfather taught me.
sentences.translation: Men ot mina olaman. — Rostdanmi? Men **ham**! Bobom o'rgatgan.

sentences.text: My brother has lived in London for five years, and **so has** my cousin.
sentences.translation: Akam besh yildan beri Londonda yashaydi, amakivachcham **ham**.

sentences.text: James would like to visit Uzbekistan. — **So would** I. It looks amazing.
sentences.translation: Jeyms O'zbekistonga borishni xohlaydi. — Men **ham**. Ajoyib joyga o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: The children should wear warm clothes, and **so should** you.
sentences.translation: Bolalar issiq kiyinishi kerak, siz **ham**.

sentences.text: Our team has won five games this season. — **So has** ours.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz bu mavsumda beshta o'yinda g'alaba qozondi. — Bizniki **ham**.

sentences.text: Madina will need a visa for Britain, and **so will** her husband.
sentences.translation: Madinaga Britaniya uchun viza kerak bo'ladi, eriga **ham**.

examples.title: **Neither am I** / **Neither do I** / **Me neither**
examples.description: Inkor gapga rozilik: **Neither + yordamchi fe'l + ega**; neither dan keyin fe'l darak shaklda. So'zlashuvda — **Me neither**.

sentences.text: I'm not hungry. — **Neither am I**. Let's eat later.
sentences.translation: Qornim och emas. — Meniki **ham**. Keyinroq ovqatlanaylik.

sentences.text: I don't like horror films. — **Neither do I**. They're too scary.
sentences.translation: Qo'rqinchli filmlarni yoqtirmayman. — Men **ham**. Ular juda vahimali.

sentences.text: Aziz can't come tomorrow, and **neither can** Bekzod.
sentences.translation: Aziz ertaga kela olmaydi, Bekzod **ham**.

sentences.text: My alarm didn't ring this morning. — **Neither did** mine! Maybe there was a power cut.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab budilnigim jiringlamadi. — Meniki **ham**! Balki tok o'chgandir.

sentences.text: Tom hasn't been to Scotland, and **neither has** his wife.
sentences.translation: Tom Shotlandiyada bo'lmagan, xotini **ham**.

sentences.text: Nobody answered because I wasn't at home, and **neither was** my husband.
sentences.translation: Hech kim javob bermadi, chunki men uyda yo'q edim, erim **ham**.

sentences.text: Madina doesn't eat sweets, and **neither does** her mother.
sentences.translation: Madina shirinlik yemaydi, onasi **ham**.

sentences.text: Sarah won't be at the meeting on Monday, and **neither will** James.
sentences.translation: Sara dushanba kungi yig'ilishda bo'lmaydi, Jeyms **ham**.

sentences.text: The first hotel wasn't very clean, and **neither was** the second.
sentences.translation: Birinchi mehmonxona unchalik toza emasdi, ikkinchisi **ham**.

sentences.text: I haven't got any cash with me. — **Me neither**. Let's find a cash machine.
sentences.translation: Yonimda naqd pul yo'q. — Menda **ham**. Keling, bankomat topaylik.

examples.title: Agree or disagree: **So do I.** / **Oh, I don't.**
examples.description: Rozi bo'lsangiz — So / Neither; fikringiz boshqacha bo'lsa — oddiy qisqa javob: I love winter. — Oh, **I don't**. O'zbekchada «Men **esa** ...».

sentences.text: I love winter. — Oh, **I don't**. I prefer summer.
sentences.translation: Men qishni juda yaxshi ko'raman. — Men esa **yoqtirmayman**. Menga yoz yoqadi.

sentences.text: I'm not very good at maths. — Really? **I am**. I can help you.
sentences.translation: Matematikadan unchalik kuchli emasman. — Rostdanmi? Men esa **kuchliman**. Sizga yordam beraman.

sentences.text: Bekzod didn't like the film. — Oh, **I did**. I thought it was great.
sentences.translation: Bekzodga film yoqmadi. — Menga esa **yoqdi**. Menimcha, zo'r edi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza can't cook at all. — **Neither can I**. Let's order a pizza.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza umuman ovqat pishira olmaydi. — Men **ham**. Keling, pitsa buyurtma qilamiz.

sentences.text: My parents have been to Paris. — Have they? Mine **haven't**.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam Parijda bo'lishgan. — Shunaqami? Mening ota-onam esa **bo'lmagan**.

sentences.text: We're going to the match on Saturday. — **So are we**! Let's go together.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni o'yinga boramiz. — Biz **ham**! Birga boraylik.

sentences.text: Sarah doesn't drink coffee. — Oh, **I do**. I have three cups a day.
sentences.translation: Sara qahva ichmaydi. — Men esa **ichaman**. Kuniga uch finjon ichaman.

sentences.text: Aziz wasn't at the party. — **Neither was** Emma. I wonder why.
sentences.translation: Aziz ziyofatda yo'q edi. — Emma **ham**. Nega ekan?

sentences.text: I've never eaten sushi. — Haven't you? **I have**, many times.
sentences.translation: Men hech qachon sushi yemaganman. — Shunaqami? Men esa **yeganman**, ko'p marta.

sentences.text: Madina thinks the book is boring. — Does she? **I don't**. It's one of my favourites.
sentences.translation: Madina kitobni zerikarli deb hisoblaydi. — Shunaqami? Men esa **unday hisoblamayman**. Bu eng sevimli kitoblarimdan biri.

examples.title: Dialogue: two new students in London
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: Londondagi til maktabida ikki o'zbek talaba tanishadi. **too**, **either**, **So did I**, **Neither can I**, **So am I** suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Hi! Are you a new student **too**?
sentences.translation: — Salom! Siz **ham** yangi talabamisiz?

sentences.text: — Yes, **I am**. I arrived from Tashkent last week.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **yangiman**. O'tgan hafta Toshkentdan keldim.

sentences.text: — Really? **So did I**! I'm Dilnoza, from Samarkand.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Men **ham**! Men Dilnoza, Samarqanddanman.

sentences.text: — Nice to meet you. I'm Aziz. I **can't understand** the London accent at all!
sentences.translation: — Tanishganimdan xursandman, men Aziz. London talaffuzini umuman **tushunolmayapman**!

sentences.text: — **Neither can I**! People speak so fast here.
sentences.translation: — Men **ham**! Bu yerda odamlar juda tez gapirishadi.

sentences.text: — But I **really like** the city. The parks are beautiful.
sentences.translation: — Lekin shahar menga juda **yoqadi**. Bog'lari chiroyli.

sentences.text: — **So do I**. And the museums are free **too**!
sentences.translation: — Menga **ham**. Muzeylar **ham** bepul!

sentences.text: — I**'m going** on the school trip to Oxford on Saturday.
sentences.translation: — Shanba kuni maktab bilan Oksfordga sayohatga **boraman**.

sentences.text: — **So am I**! Let's sit together on the bus.
sentences.translation: — Men **ham**! Avtobusda birga o'tiraylik.

sentences.text: — Great. I haven't seen Oxford, and I haven't seen Cambridge **either**.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Men Oksfordni ko'rmaganman, Kembrijni **ham** ko'rmaganman.
